objective: Assess the just-bash backend for security issues in how it resolves and runs host executables and handles the environment.
scope: Trace: command text from the model to host process spawn (PATH resolution, a project-local file shadowing a host program, PATHEXT and .cmd/.bat argument quoting on Windows, injection through arguments), the in-memory /usr/bin and /bin stubs, the environment passed to children (secrets, the real PATH), the Billion Context guardrail settings write (scope, symlinks, a project config switching them), the TypeScript/JavaScript execution sandbox, and the bundled dist script (no machine paths, no fetched code at runtime).
constraints: Do not check out other commits in any checkout and make no edits.
Report in under 400 words; substantiate each finding with source, sink, file and line, and mark it blocking or non-blocking.

criteria.text: The backend runs only what the command names, resolves host programs safely, and writes settings only where intended
